text:
marta: heads-up — deploybot auto-paused canary promotion to staging. seeing cache-restore failures + a couple flaky order-dependent tests :warning:
liam: link to pipeline? logs?
marta: https://ci.internal/build/37222
marta: snippet:
```
EtagMismatchError: expected etag=abc123 got=abc122
Retrying restore (attempt 3/3) -> failed
TestSuite::OrderSensitiveTest random_seed=42 -> failed
```
sam: hmm, etag drift on the cache layer again. Do we pin to last-good image or rerun? :thinking:
liam: rerun will likely hit same cache restore issue. pin to 2024-04-19-canary-7? that's the last green
jax: pinning reduces blast radius but delays rollback plan. We should consider manual promote vs rollback to previous release. what's in release notes for this cut? any DB migration?
marta: no DB migrations. release notes mention feature flags only. conservative approach = pin and open a postmortem + follow-up task to fix cache etag generator
deploy-bot: Promotion paused by policy: artifact-checksum-failure (3 workers)
sam: ok let's pin to tag `canary-20240419-7` and hold change window to 09:00 UTC tomorrow for manual promote after infra fix
liam: i'll create ticket and add to release notes: `Blocked on cache-restore etag mismatch; pinned canary image as mitigation. Action: infra to investigate cache metadata TTL.`
jax: add rollback plan in the notes: if staging shows further regressions, we'll revert to prod image and cancel cut
marta: +1. can someone trigger a controlled rerun of the failing suite on a clean runner to validate? if clean run passes, maybe it's infra-only
liam: i'll queue a clean run and tag @infra
infra: noted — checking cache service logs, will report back in ~20m :mag_right:
sam: thanks. Marking release as delayed in the change window doc and adding the pin to deploybot overrides :thumbsup:
marta: thanks all. will update release notes and close with final decision after infra report
